本版采用每日训练的案例写法：先分析事件，再展开参考答案。保留1,000个练习、25个主题和原有操作。它们来自100个基础情境的十种决策练习，并非1,000个独立编写的事件。

This edition uses the daily-training case style: analyze the incident before opening the answer. It retains 1,000 exercises, 25 topics and the original controls. These are ten guided decisions for each of 100 underlying situations, not 1,000 independently authored incidents.

本次是写法与编排改写，现行法规核验未完成。参考答案的“必须事项”列出初稿中的安全处理底线，不代表完整、已核实的法定义务。场景人数、时间及金额是练习事实，不是法律门槛。模板中的旧核验日期没有作为本版核验结果沿用。

This is a writing and presentation revision; current rule verification is incomplete. “Required actions” sets out draft safety safeguards, not a complete verified statement of legal duties. Scenario counts, times and amounts are exercise facts, not legal thresholds. The template’s earlier checked dates have not been reused as verification for this edition.

1. Supervision & transitions 监管与活动转换

WA-0001 · CORE-0001 · FAM-001 · center · DRAFT

门口交接 — 即时处理
Doorway handoff — Immediate response

早晨入园时，Mia把Leo带过相连教室的门，Jordan正在帮助另一名孩子。Mia说：“我以为你接手了。”Jordan回答：“我以为你还在看着。”接收组的名单还没标明Leo。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。

At morning arrival, Mia takes Leo through a connecting doorway while Jordan helps another child. Mia says, “I thought you had him,” and Jordan replies, “I thought you were staying.” Leo is not yet marked on the receiving group's list. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.

作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“门口交接”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。附近有成人，不代表对方知道自己已经接手照看。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Doorway handoff”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证监管、活动转换与出勤程序。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify supervision, transitions, and attendance procedures for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

WA-0002 · CORE-0002 · FAM-001 · home · DRAFT

门口交接 — 独自工作
Doorway handoff — Working alone

住宅托育的门口，一名孩子开始走向另一个房间。家中成人说可以暂时帮忙看，但资格未确认，你仍负责全组。本题设在家庭托育场所，现场只有你一位合格照护者，没有已确认可立即接手的第二个人。

At a residential care doorway, a child starts moving toward another room. A household adult says they can watch briefly, but their eligibility has not been established. You are still responsible for the group. In this version the setting is a family child-care home, and you are the only qualified caregiver on site. No approved second caregiver is immediately available.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？

As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

继续负责这个孩子和全组。没有已核实合格人员明确接手，就不让孩子独自进入另一房间。使用可安全照看的获准区域，不能继续安全照护时启用允许的应变安排。

Keep responsibility for the child and group. Do not send the child through the doorway without a verified eligible person clearly accepting care. Use the safe approved area and the permitted contingency plan if safe care cannot continue.

实务处理 / Practical approach

你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。

Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.

WA-0003 · CORE-0003 · FAM-001 · center · DRAFT

门口交接 — 要求破例
Doorway handoff — Pressure for an exception

早晨入园时，Mia把Leo带过相连教室的门，Jordan正在帮助另一名孩子。Mia说：“我以为你接手了。”Jordan回答：“我以为你还在看着。”接收组的名单还没标明Leo。有人希望今天先通融，因为改变计划不方便。但实际情况和所谓例外，并没有因此得到确认。

At morning arrival, Mia takes Leo through a connecting doorway while Jordan helps another child. Mia says, “I thought you had him,” and Jordan replies, “I thought you were staying.” Leo is not yet marked on the receiving group's list. Someone asks you to overlook the concern just for today because changing plans would be inconvenient. The relevant facts and any claimed exception have not changed.

作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？你会怎样解释，并提供什么替代安排，而不承诺未经核实的例外？

As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What would you explain, and what alternative could you offer without promising an unverified exception?

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

平静说明这次具体顾虑，提供本事件可行的安全安排。不便或同意，都不能证明法律上确有例外。

Explain the specific concern calmly and offer the safe option identified for this event. Do not turn inconvenience or consent into proof that a legal exception exists.

WA-0004 · CORE-0004 · FAM-001 · home · DRAFT

门口交接 — 代班交接
Doorway handoff — Substitute handoff

早晨入园时，Mia把Leo带过相连教室的门，Jordan正在帮助另一名孩子。Mia说：“我以为你接手了。”Jordan回答：“我以为你还在看着。”接收组的名单还没标明Leo。合格代班人员稍后接手。他熟悉平时作息，却不知道这次发生了什么、已做了哪些防护，以及什么还没解决。

At morning arrival, Mia takes Leo through a connecting doorway while Jordan helps another child. Mia says, “I thought you had him,” and Jordan replies, “I thought you were staying.” Leo is not yet marked on the receiving group's list. A qualified substitute is due to take over later. They know the usual routine but have not been told what happened, which safeguards are in place or what remains unresolved.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？交接前，代班人员必须能说清什么、找到什么？

As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? Before responsibility changes, what must the substitute be able to explain and find?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

交代本事件、现有防护、必要的儿童个人说明和未决事项。请代班人员说出下一步并找到相关记录，再明确交接；实际岗位资格另行核实。

Brief the substitute on this event, the current safeguard, necessary child-specific instructions and any unresolved decision. Have them explain the next action and locate the relevant record before a clear handoff. Verify their actual role separately.

WA-0005 · CORE-0005 · FAM-001 · center · DRAFT

门口交接 — 说法与记录不符
Doorway handoff — Conflicting accounts

早晨入园时，Mia把Leo带过相连教室的门，Jordan正在帮助另一名孩子。Mia说：“我以为你接手了。”Jordan回答：“我以为你还在看着。”接收组的名单还没标明Leo。同事说问题已经解决，现有记录却不能证明。你还无法确定哪种说法准确。

At morning arrival, Mia takes Leo through a connecting doorway while Jordan helps another child. Mia says, “I thought you had him,” and Jordan replies, “I thought you were staying.” Leo is not yet marked on the receiving group's list. A coworker says the issue has already been resolved, but the available record does not confirm it. You cannot yet establish which account is accurate.

作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？你会保留、核实和更正什么？哪些紧急行动不能等到大家说法一致？

As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What would you preserve, verify and correct, and which urgent actions must not wait for agreement?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

保留原始说法，区分亲见、转述和未知。根据实际依据，留下有日期、可追溯的补充或更正。不能为了统一故事拖延紧急照护或已经要求的报告。

Keep each original account and separate observations, reported information and unknown facts. Make a dated, traceable clarification using actual evidence. Do not delay urgent care or an already-required report to produce one agreed story.

WA-0006 · CORE-0006 · FAM-001 · home · DRAFT

门口交接 — 帮手职责未核实
Doorway handoff — Unverified helper

早晨入园时，Mia把Leo带过相连教室的门，Jordan正在帮助另一名孩子。Mia说：“我以为你接手了。”Jordan回答：“我以为你还在看着。”接收组的名单还没标明Leo。有人愿意帮忙，但其承担儿童照护或接触保密资料的资格尚未核实。其他员工觉得热心就够了。

At morning arrival, Mia takes Leo through a connecting doorway while Jordan helps another child. Mia says, “I thought you had him,” and Jordan replies, “I thought you were staying.” Leo is not yet marked on the receiving group's list. A helper offers to deal with the issue, but their eligibility for child care or confidential information has not been checked. Other staff assume willingness is enough.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？你可以考虑交出哪些工作，哪些责任必须由合格人员保留？

As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? Which tasks could you consider delegating, and which responsibilities must stay with eligible people?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

只考虑该人实际职责允许的任务。不因对方愿意帮忙，就交出看护、算作合格人员或开放私人记录。安全照护责任必须明确。

Consider only tasks allowed for the person’s actual role. Do not transfer supervision, count the helper as qualified staff or disclose private records merely because help was offered. Keep the safe-care responsibility clearly assigned.

You cannot yet establish which account is accurate.

保留原始说法，区分亲见、转述和未知。根据实际依据，留下有日期、可追溯的补充或更正。不能为了统一故事拖延紧急照护或已经要求的报告。

员工提交一张网课结业证。课程名称看起来相关，但培训机构、上课形式和是否符合所需类别都没有核对。档案马上要被标成已完成。有人希望今天先通融，因为改变计划不方便。但实际情况和所谓例外，并没有因此得到确认。

A worker submits an online course certificate. The title sounds relevant, but nobody has checked the provider, delivery format or whether the course meets the required training category. The file is about to be marked complete. Someone asks you to overlook the concern just for today because changing plans would be inconvenient. The relevant facts and any claimed exception have not changed.

作为园长，接受课程、标记完成前，你要核对什么？你会怎样解释，并提供什么替代安排，而不承诺未经核实的例外？

As director, what would you check before accepting this course and marking the requirement complete? What would you explain, and what alternative could you offer without promising an unverified exception?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

核对培训内容、机构、上课形式和完成证明是否符合适用要求。

Match the course to the authority's accepted training requirements. A printed certificate by itself does not show the course is accepted.

实务处理 / Practical approach

平静说明这次具体顾虑，提供本事件可行的安全安排。不便或同意，都不能证明法律上确有例外。

Explain the specific concern calmly and offer the safe option identified for this event. Do not turn inconvenience or consent into proof that a legal exception exists.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“网络课程证书”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。有结业证书，不一定代表课程获认可。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Online certificate”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A certificate can show completion without proving the course is accepted. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证必需培训、更新与人员覆盖规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify required training, renewal, and coverage rules for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

婴儿床内软物 — 即时处理
Soft object in crib — Immediate response

日常查看时，员工发现婴儿睡眠区域里有毛绒玩具。本例中婴儿没有异常表现。家长说家里一直这样用，希望机构也保留。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。

During a routine check, a worker sees a stuffed toy in an infant's sleep space. The infant has no signs of distress in this example. The parent says the same toy is always used at home and asks that it stay. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.

作为园长，怎样移除睡眠危险，并向家庭解释决定？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Remove the stuffed toy from the infant’s sleep space, maintain supervision and explain the safe-sleep procedure to the parent. A familiar item from home does not establish that it belongs in the sleep space.

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

日常查看时，员工发现婴儿睡眠区域里有毛绒玩具。本例中婴儿没有异常表现。家长说家里一直这样用，希望机构也保留。同事说问题已经解决，现有记录却不能证明。你还无法确定哪种说法准确。

During a routine check, a worker sees a stuffed toy in an infant's sleep space. The infant has no signs of distress in this example. The parent says the same toy is always used at home and asks that it stay. A coworker says the issue has already been resolved, but the available record does not confirm it. You cannot yet establish which account is accurate.

作为园长，怎样移除睡眠危险，并向家庭解释决定？你会保留、核实和更正什么？哪些紧急行动不能等到大家说法一致？

移走婴儿睡眠区域里的毛绒玩具，继续照看，并向家长解释安全睡眠做法。家中熟悉的物品，不代表适合留在睡眠区域。

Remove the stuffed toy from the infant’s sleep space, maintain supervision and explain the safe-sleep procedure to the parent. A familiar item from home does not establish that it belongs in the sleep space.

实务处理 / Practical approach

保留原始说法，区分亲见、转述和未知。根据实际依据，留下有日期、可追溯的补充或更正。不能为了统一故事拖延紧急照护或已经要求的报告。

Keep each original account and separate observations, reported information and unknown facts. Make a dated, traceable clarification using actual evidence. Do not delay urgent care or an already-required report to produce one agreed story.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证婴儿睡眠设备、姿势、观察与例外规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Sleeping in equipment — Immediate response

晨间活动中，一名婴儿在摇椅里睡着了。员工担心转移会把孩子弄醒，想让他继续睡。但该设备并未被确认可作为婴儿睡眠表面。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。

An infant falls asleep in a swing during the morning routine. A worker wants to leave the infant there rather than risk waking them. The equipment has not been established as an appropriate infant sleep surface. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.

作为园长，你会让婴儿继续在这个设备中睡吗？怎样安排安全睡眠和持续查看？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

把婴儿安全转到合适的婴儿睡眠空间，继续所需查看。不因担心转移会弄醒，就把摇椅当成固定睡眠地点。

Safely transfer the infant from the swing to an appropriate infant sleep space and continue the required observation. Do not turn the swing into the routine sleep place because transfer might wake the infant.

实务处理 / Practical approach

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

共用餐具 — 即时处理
Shared utensil — Immediate response

一把勺子从一种食物移到另一名孩子的餐食中。员工知道两份食物所含过敏原不同，却未核对第二份是否已受影响。有人说换一把干净勺子就行。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。

A serving spoon moves from one food into another child's meal. Staff know the foods have different allergen ingredients but have not checked whether the second meal is affected. Someone says a clean spoon will fix the problem. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.

作为园长，换勺子够吗？已经可能受到影响的食物怎么处理？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

停止共用餐具，把可能受到交叉接触影响的食物另放，用清洁用品按计划准备合适替代食物。

Stop using the shared utensil. Set aside food affected by cross-contact, use clean equipment, and prepare a suitable replacement under the allergy plan.

实务处理 / Practical approach

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

返园信息只写孩子“好多了”。机构没核对这句话是否满足实际返园条件或现行卫生指导，员工对能否据此接收意见不一。有人希望今天先通融，因为改变计划不方便。但实际情况和所谓例外，并没有因此得到确认。

A return-to-care message says only that the child is “better.” The program has not checked whether the message addresses its actual return criteria or current health direction. Staff disagree about whether the note settles the matter. Someone asks you to overlook the concern just for today because changing plans would be inconvenient. The relevant facts and any claimed exception have not changed.

作为园长，依赖这份返园信息前，你需要问清什么？你会怎样解释，并提供什么替代安排，而不承诺未经核实的例外？

As director, what would you clarify before relying on this return-to-care message? What would you explain, and what alternative could you offer without promising an unverified exception?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

读清返园信息，核对适用条件；不明确的地方先确认，不把模糊说明当作自动许可。

Read what the return message actually says and compare it with applicable return criteria. Ask for clarification rather than treating an unclear note as automatic clearance.

实务处理 / Practical approach

平静说明这次具体顾虑，提供本事件可行的安全安排。不便或同意，都不能证明法律上确有例外。

Explain the specific concern calmly and offer the safe option identified for this event. Do not turn inconvenience or consent into proof that a legal exception exists.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“返园说明不清”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。说明不清的返园纸条，不能解决所有返园条件。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Return note ambiguity”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An unclear note does not settle every return-to-care requirement. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证疾病离园、返园、通知与健康指导。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify illness exclusion, return, notification, and health guidance for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

孩子已经在换尿布台上，照护者才发现用品放在房间另一侧。他准备短暂走开，旁边另一个孩子也需要帮助。本题设在家庭托育场所，现场只有你一位合格照护者，没有已确认可立即接手的第二个人。

A child is already on the changing surface when the caregiver discovers the supplies are across the room. The caregiver plans to walk away briefly. Another child also needs attention nearby. In this version the setting is a family child-care home, and you are the only qualified caregiver on site. No approved second caregiver is immediately available.

作为家庭托育负责人，现在怎样安顿孩子，又怎样防止用品没备齐的问题重演？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？

As the family child-care provider, what would you do with the child now, and how would you prevent the supply problem from recurring? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

开始前备齐用品；缺东西时也要保持儿童安全有人照看，不能转身走开。

Gather supplies before starting. If something is missing, keep the child safely attended and use a safe alternative; do not walk away from the changing surface.

实务处理 / Practical approach

你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。

Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证手部卫生、换尿布、如厕与消毒规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify hand hygiene, diapering, toileting, and sanitation for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. An incident received immediate attention, but nobody assigned the follow-up notifications. The parent heard an informal account, and staff assume that covers all reporting. The program has not checked the event-specific recipients or deadlines. In this version the setting is a family child-care home, and you are the only qualified caregiver on site. No approved second caregiver is immediately available.

作为家庭托育负责人，你会分别核对哪些通知，明确谁负责每项后续？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

分别确认家庭、许可机构、保护机构或卫生部门等适用通知对象和时限，不以一次电话代替全部要求。

Identify each required recipient and deadline from the applicable rule. A call to the parent does not automatically satisfy a licensing or protective-reporting duty.

实务处理 / Practical approach

你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。

Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.

保留“事故通知延误”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。通知一个对象，不一定完成另一项报告义务。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证急救照护、事故记录与报告规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Conflicting witness accounts — Immediate response

两名目击者对同一事件说法不同。有人建议先统一版本再记录或报告，却没有另外处理孩子照护和可能有时限的报告责任。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。

Two witnesses give different accounts of the same event. Someone suggests producing one agreed version before any record or report is made. The child's care needs and any time-sensitive reporting duties have not been separately addressed. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.

作为园长，怎样分别保存目击者陈述，同时不拖延照护或已经要求的报告？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

As director, how would you preserve each witness's account without delaying care or an already-required report? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

分别保存每位目击者的事实陈述，注明未知情况，不等意见一致才提供照护或作已要求的报告。

Write each witness's own account separately and record what is unknown. Do not postpone needed care or a required report until everyone agrees.

实务处理 / Practical approach

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“目击说法冲突”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。说法不同，不应成为改写事实或拖延照护的理由。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Conflicting witness accounts”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Different accounts do not justify rewriting history or delaying care. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证急救照护、事故记录与报告规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify emergency care, incident documentation, and reporting for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

儿童披露 — 即时处理
Child disclosure — Immediate response

游戏时，孩子说：“昨晚有人弄疼我。”照护者不知道具体经过，想帮忙。同事建议先问其他孩子，看能否证明。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。

During play, a child says, “Someone hurt me last night.” The caregiver is unsure what happened and wants to help. A coworker suggests questioning other children first to see whether the account can be proved. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.

作为园长，你会怎样回应孩子、准确记录并报告，而不自行调查？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

平静倾听，不承诺保密、不诱导追问，记录儿童原话，并依法及时报告；即时危险要紧急求助。

Listen calmly. Do not promise secrecy or question the child to prove what happened. Record the child's own words and use the required reporting route; seek emergency help for immediate danger.

实务处理 / Practical approach

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

行为标签 — 说明处理经过
Behavior labels — Explaining the response

行为记录只写“Ava又很坏”。目击者实际看到的是，同伴拿走小车后，Ava把积木推向对方。成人回应和结果没有写。获授权审阅人员问你当时知道什么、做了什么，以及怎样判断问题已解决。团队有部分记录，也有未确定事实。

The behavior record says only, “Ava was bad again.” A witness actually saw a peer take a truck, followed by Ava pushing a block toward that child. The adult response and outcome are missing. An authorized reviewer asks what you knew, what you did and how you decided whether the issue was resolved. The team has some records but also unresolved facts.

作为家庭托育负责人，你会怎样重写记录，说明事件、背景、成人回应和结果？你会提供什么真实时间线和证据，又会说明哪些不确定性？

As the family child-care provider, how would you rewrite the record to show the event, context, adult response and outcome? What factual timeline and evidence would you provide, and what uncertainty would you disclose?

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

写清观察事实：“同伴拿走小车后，Ava把积木推向对方。”再记实际成人回应和结果。不知道的地方如实注明，不为记录完整而编出一次帮助。

Write the observed event: “After a peer took the truck, Ava pushed a block toward that child.” Add the actual adult response and outcome. If either is unknown, record that uncertainty rather than invent a helpful response.

实务处理 / Practical approach

按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。

Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.

保留“行为标签”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。描述事实有助于支持儿童，标签只是评价儿童。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Behavior labels”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A description helps plan support; a label only judges the child. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

A worker proposes ending a child's enrollment immediately after repeated difficulties. 实务处理 / Practical approach

只考虑该人实际职责允许的任务。不因对方愿意帮忙，就交出看护、算作合格人员或开放私人记录。安全照护责任必须明确。

Consider only tasks allowed for the person’s actual role. Do not transfer supervision, count the helper as qualified staff or disclose private records merely because help was offered. Keep the safe-care responsibility clearly assigned.

支持信息缺口 — 说法与记录不符
Support information gap — Conflicting accounts

员工被安排执行个人照护计划，却没收到必要说明。同事说计划保密，所以完全不能分享。交接马上就要发生。同事说问题已经解决，现有记录却不能证明。你还无法确定哪种说法准确。

A worker is assigned to implement an individual care plan but has not received the necessary instructions. A coworker says the plan is confidential and therefore cannot be shared at all. The handoff is due shortly. A coworker says the issue has already been resolved, but the available record does not confirm it. You cannot yet establish which account is accurate.

作为园长，交接责任前，必须补齐哪些必要说明和人员准备？你会保留、核实和更正什么？哪些紧急行动不能等到大家说法一致？

As director, what necessary information and readiness checks must be completed before responsibility transfers? What would you preserve, verify and correct, and which urgent actions must not wait for agreement?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

交接前向需知情的员工提供必要说明，请其复述下一步，同时限制无关隐私资料。

Before a worker takes over, give them the child's necessary care instructions and have them explain what they will do. Keep unrelated private details restricted.

实务处理 / Practical approach

保留原始说法，区分亲见、转述和未知。根据实际依据，留下有日期、可追溯的补充或更正。不能为了统一故事拖延紧急照护或已经要求的报告。

Keep each original account and separate observations, reported information and unknown facts. Make a dated, traceable clarification using actual evidence. Do not delay urgent care or an already-required report to produce one agreed story.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“支持信息缺口”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。员工没收到照护计划，就难以正确执行。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Support information gap”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A worker cannot reliably follow a plan they have never received. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证合理调整、开除、通知与反歧视规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify reasonable modifications, expulsion, notice, and nondiscrimination for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

非正式缩短时间 — 即时处理
Informal shortened schedule — Immediate response

孩子在困难转场后反复被要求提前回家。每次都称临时安排，没有被当作出勤变化审查，也没有记录并试行支持计划。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。

A child is repeatedly sent home early after difficult transitions. Each event is described as a one-off favor rather than a change in attendance. The program has not reviewed the combined pattern or tried a documented support plan. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.

作为园长，怎样审查反复提前接走的模式，以及尚未尝试的支持？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

继续照看儿童，同时核实成人身份和当前接走授权；证件本身不能证明接走权限。

Keep the child supervised while checking the adult's identity and current pickup authorization. A driver's license identifies the adult but does not prove permission to collect this child.

实务处理 / Practical approach

交代本事件、现有防护、必要的儿童个人说明和未决事项。请代班人员说出下一步并找到相关记录，再明确交接；实际岗位资格另行核实。

Brief the substitute on this event, the current safeguard, necessary child-specific instructions and any unresolved decision. Have them explain the next action and locate the relevant record before a clear handoff. Verify their actual role separately.

保留“陌生接送人”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。知道成人是谁，不等于知道其有权接走这个儿童。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Unknown pickup adult”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Identity and permission to collect a particular child are separate checks. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

户外活动准备开始，员工看的却是昨天的信息。当前警报和天气安排没查，也没有商量好的室内替代活动。获授权审阅人员问你当时知道什么、做了什么，以及怎样判断问题已解决。团队有部分记录，也有未确定事实。

An outdoor activity is about to begin using yesterday's weather information. Current alerts and the program's weather plan have not been checked. Staff do not have an agreed indoor alternative. An authorized reviewer asks what you knew, what you did and how you decided whether the issue was resolved. The team has some records but also unresolved facts.

实务处理 / Practical approach

按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。

Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.

实务处理 / Practical approach

只考虑该人实际职责允许的任务。不因对方愿意帮忙，就交出看护、算作合格人员或开放私人记录。安全照护责任必须明确。

Consider only tasks allowed for the person’s actual role. Do not transfer supervision, count the helper as qualified staff or disclose private records merely because help was offered. Keep the safe-care responsibility clearly assigned.

补助授权已变，账单仍用旧资料。生效日期还没与账期对应，记账人员想覆盖旧记录，而不是留下更正。类似问题不久前发生过，当时只作口头提醒。流程或设备没有变化，问题又出现了。

A subsidy authorization changes, but billing continues using the previous information. The effective date has not been matched to the billing period. The bookkeeper wants to overwrite the old entry rather than document a correction. A similar problem occurred recently and received a verbal reminder. WA-0890 · CORE-0890 · FAM-089 · home · DRAFT

所有权变更 — 说明处理经过
Ownership change — Explaining the response

生意转让时照护继续，新经营者认为许可证会随生意一起转移。在依赖旧许可营业前，批准和通知要求都没核对。获授权审阅人员问你当时知道什么、做了什么，以及怎样判断问题已解决。团队有部分记录，也有未确定事实。

Ownership changes while the care program continues operating. The new owner assumes the existing license transfers with the business. Approval and notification requirements have not been checked before relying on that license. An authorized reviewer asks what you knew, what you did and how you decided whether the issue was resolved. The team has some records but also unresolved facts.

作为家庭托育负责人，新经营者依赖旧许可营业前，必须确认什么？你会提供什么真实时间线和证据，又会说明哪些不确定性？

As the family child-care provider, what must be established before the new owner relies on the existing license to operate? What factual timeline and evidence would you provide, and what uncertainty would you disclose?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

依赖旧许可营业前，核实所有权变更所需批准和通知，不把转让当成普通联系资料更新。

Check required licensing approval and notice before relying on the old license under new ownership. Do not assume a business sale transfers permission to operate.

实务处理 / Practical approach

按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。

Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“所有权变更”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。转让生意，不一定同时转让托育许可。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Ownership change”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A business transfer does not necessarily transfer a child-care license. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证许可类别、变更、检查、整改与申诉规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify license category, changes, inspections, corrections, and appeals for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

检查访问不明 — 要求破例
Inspection access confusion — Pressure for an exception

经理不在时，一人自称检查员到场。员工不知怎样核实和安排合法访问：有人想一律等经理，有人想不核实就交记录。有人希望今天先通融，因为改变计划不方便。但实际情况和所谓例外，并没有因此得到确认。

A person presents as an inspector while the manager is absent. Staff are unsure how to verify identity and arrange lawful access. One worker proposes a manager-only rule; another wants to provide records without verification. Someone asks you to overlook the concern just for today because changing plans would be inconvenient. The relevant facts and any claimed exception have not changed.

作为园长，怎样及时核实检查员并提供合法访问，同时不向未核实人员披露资料？你会怎样解释，并提供什么替代安排，而不承诺未经核实的例外？

As director, how would you verify the inspector promptly and provide lawful access without disclosing to an unverified person? What would you explain, and what alternative could you offer without promising an unverified exception?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

及时按官方方法核实检查员并提供合法访问，不自行设定必须经理在场才可检查。

Follow the official identity-check procedure promptly and arrange lawful access. Do not invent a manager-only rule that blocks an authorized inspection.

实务处理 / Practical approach

平静说明这次具体顾虑，提供本事件可行的安全安排。不便或同意，都不能证明法律上确有例外。

Explain the specific concern calmly and offer the safe option identified for this event. Do not turn inconvenience or consent into proof that a legal exception exists.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“检查访问不明”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。核实身份应支持合法检查，不能凭空增加障碍。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Inspection access confusion”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Identity checks should support lawful access, not create an invented barrier. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证许可类别、变更、检查、整改与申诉规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify license category, changes, inspections, corrections, and appeals for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

WA-0980 · CORE-0980 · FAM-098 · home · DRAFT

险情反复 — 说明处理经过
Repeated near-miss — Explaining the response

同一种运营错误在几次口头提醒后再现。流程、设备和人员安排都没变，园长要求一个可观察、可检查的改进，而不只是再次警告。获授权审阅人员问你当时知道什么、做了什么，以及怎样判断问题已解决。团队有部分记录，也有未确定事实。

The same operational error returns after several verbal reminders. The workflow, equipment or coverage arrangement has not changed. The director asks for a correction that can be observed and tested rather than another warning. An authorized reviewer asks what you knew, what you did and how you decided whether the issue was resolved. The team has some records but also unresolved facts.

作为家庭托育负责人，什么可衡量改变能针对反复原因，又怎样检查是否有效？你会提供什么真实时间线和证据，又会说明哪些不确定性？

As the family child-care provider, what measurable change would address the recurring cause, and how would you check whether it works? What factual timeline and evidence would you provide, and what uncertainty would you disclose?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

改进具体流程、设备或人员安排，指定负责人，并观察下一几次是否真的改善。

If children repeatedly reach a delivery doorway, change the handoff arrangement and check the next several deliveries. Another reminder alone does not test the fix.

实务处理 / Practical approach

按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。

Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“险情反复”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。反复出问题，通常需要改进安排，而不只是再提醒。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Repeated near-miss”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A repeated problem often needs a changed system, not another reminder. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证政策维护、责任、记录诚信与规则更新规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向DCYF及相应卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify policy maintenance, accountability, record integrity, and rule updates for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with DCYF and the appropriate health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
